MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 22

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 32

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

6. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81

   C. 40.5
   D. 10

   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 40
   D. 75

   A. 22

   C. 55
   D. 16

   A. 23

   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 120
   D. 46

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

19. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

20. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 34
   C. 66
   D. 22

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 90

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36
